title: Guards meant for artifact tools match the names sessions really call
why: Unverified: settings.json matchers on main name `Artifact` and `ArtifactData` (lines 237, 257 and 362, read 11:12 CST Nov 8). Home triage-5 saw sessions call `mcp__claude-artifacts__*` (db_write, db_get, publish_version). If a session calls those names, the guards never fire. Probe first: list the artifact tool names on the Mac and in the cloud. Done when: each guard meant for artifact tools matches every live name, proved by a test that goes red on the old matcher, or the probe shows no gap. Home coordinator hand-off, relayed by the owner as ask ask-mw839r77zp (11:11 CST Nov 8; Home notes, PR 581). The owner is unsure all still hold, so the lane checks first.
note: Coordinator 11:16 CST Nov 8: lane started. Lane 11:19 CST Nov 8: no gap in the cloud; the live names are Artifact, ArtifactData and ArtifactComments, and main names no claude-artifacts tool. Needs nested input shapes of db_write (ops), db_str_replace (path, field), db_get (path) and publish_files (files). Owner task 440 (home-artifact-input-shapes) posted 12:26 CST. Owner answered item 440 at 12:28 CST Nov 8 (from Home transcripts): db_write ops entries are {op, path, data, ifVersion}, op in set/merge/update/delete, collection is path's first segment (items, receipts, groups, meta); db_str_replace path items/<id> plus field; db_get path <collection>/<id>; publish_files files is a list of {as, path} (uri optional); db_query and db_list take a bare collection.
